- Minimum acceptance thresholds (precision/recall, hallucination heuristics) per scenario

On Tue, Jun 18, 2029 at 9:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick request — Acme Health asked for a short walkthrough of the evals we're planning to run against the promptset for their triage workflow.

SG — good call getting this in front of them early. A few concrete asks from product side:
- For A/B we should define both user-facing metrics (task success rate, time-to-resolution) and safety signals (NER hallucinations, incorrect PHI handling).
- Proposed acceptance thresholds: task success >= 88% on gold set; hallucination rate <= 2% on sampled set (we can calibrate).
- Canary: 3% of traffic, 24-hour lookback for freshness, automatic rollback on either drop in task success >4pp or hallucination spike >1pp.

I've attached a small promptset sample you can show them to make the conversation concrete (promptset-sample.json).

Availability: Thu 9–11am or Fri 1–3pm PT for the walkthrough.

- Marissa
